        "Entry884 checks text/x-moz-address before generic attachment extraction in envelopeDragObserver.onDrop and excludes that flavor during onDragOver. A contact drag can also advertise attachment-like data; flavor priority prevents those contacts becoming attachments. Outside about:blank?compose, DropRecipient creates recipient pills and preventDefault prevents default text insertion. A body drop returns to normal editor handling. Existing internal-body and attachment-reorder guards stay ahead of this classification.",
        "All three complete historical diffs were read, including removal of isDropping and address side effects from getValidAttachments, updated callers, deletion of DragAddressOverTargetControl, and the browser-test addition. The current attachment helper still changes gIsValidInline, so separating recipient side effects does not make it a pure function. The current contact-list producer is cardsPane._onDragStart: it places a combined address string at item0 and adds per-card text/x-moz-url, vCard, and file-promise data. Those overlapping flavors explain why the entire address drag must be classified before iterating attachment items. Legacy abDragDrop.js was read as the deleted helper’s file; it is not substituted for the current contact-list producer.",
        "Current DropRecipient resolves the row directly, through data-address-row, or closest .address-row; missing/raw rows return. addressRowAddRecipientsArray parses display addresses, reveals a hidden row, creates pills, updates spelling/ARIA labels, and notifies recipient changes outside Reply-To. The implementation is checked as a caller path, not live keyboard/screen-reader evidence.",
        "The test registers waitForTransition before synthesizeDragOver, then asserts absence of show before drop and verifies pill count/labels and dirty compose state afterward. The overlay animationend handler converts showing-animation to steady show, hiding-animation removes show/hiding, and _hideDropOverlay removes showing and adds hiding. A show-versus-showing comparison alone does not prove the assertion is wrong. The historical test adds no assertion message; current expected message is retained. No drag, transition, or accessibility test ran.",
        "Existing comments explain flavor collisions and editor default behavior. Exact data flavor names, side-effect boundaries, guard order, animation states, and setup/action/assertion grouping were checked. Full assigned source context from Bug1851536/D193762 still needs human discussion reconciliation; this source pass alone does not count chronological completion.",
        "Full available Bug1913600 description, human comments/updates, and footer were read. Reporter observes selected contacts becoming zero-size attachments; author attributes this to D193762 adding attachment-like flavors and explains the address-priority repair. Comment2 says reproduction can depend on drag entry direction. Numbered comments4/5/7 are absent from the rendered page and are not reconstructed. Uplift reports c-c and beta testing and very-low risk; video, regression-window jobs, duplicate bugs, and ESR source were not opened.",
        "Complete Bug1851536 description, all comments0–61, updates, and footer were read. It is a broad test program with34 revision locators. Comments20–21 and D193762 describe fixing multiple-contact filesystem drag on all platforms and record its landing. The other meta-bug work remains contextual history; thirty-three unassigned review pages and their source/test details were not audited by this entry.",
        "Complete D193762 timeline was read with zero submitted inlines and explicit acceptance. Its actual changed contact-producer context was read: one address string becomes a joined list, filesystem data becomes per-card, and text/x-moz-url is added for Linux. Complete D222539 timeline and its one actual Done author inline1235769 were read. The author calls the deleted helper long-dead; the exact historical diff removes its last call and definition. Reviewer explicitly requests browser_drag_drop.js coverage, then accepts after the overlay/pill test is added. The displayed Try-run link was not independently opened."
